# Map chlorophyll-a

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define the California bounding box
california_bbox <- c(xmin = -125, xmax = -117, ymin = 29.5, ymax = 35.5)

# Scale bar: 200 km, approximately at 32.5°N
scale_x_start <- california_bbox["xmax"] - 2.5
scale_y       <- california_bbox["ymin"] + 0.5
scale_lon     <- 200 / (111.32 * cos(32.5 * pi / 180))

# Bar divided into two 100-km segments
scale_lon_half <- scale_lon / 2

# Load rasters
rast_winter <- rast(file.path(
  project_root,
  "_Transparency",
  "C20060322C20243662024366_Chl_comp_DJF_mapped.hdf"
))
rast_spring <- rast(file.path(
  project_root,
  "_Transparency",
  "C20060602C20241522024152_Chl_comp_MAM_mapped.hdf"
))
rast_summer <- rast(file.path(
  project_root,
  "_Transparency",
  "C20061522C20242442024244_Chl_comp_JJA_mapped.hdf"
))
rast_fall <- rast(file.path(
  project_root,
  "_Transparency",
  "C20062442C20243352024335_Chl_comp_SON_mapped.hdf"
))

# Define a correction function
correct_raster <- function(r) {
  # Convert signed byte values to their unsigned representation
  r_corrected <- ifel(r >= -128 & r <= -10, r + 256, r)
  return(r_corrected)
}

# Apply correction
rast_winter <- correct_raster(rast_winter)
rast_spring <- correct_raster(rast_spring)
rast_summer <- correct_raster(rast_summer)
rast_fall   <- correct_raster(rast_fall)

rast_winter <- clamp(rast_winter[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_spring <- clamp(rast_spring[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_summer <- clamp(rast_summer[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_fall <- clamp(rast_fall[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)

crs(rast_winter) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_spring) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_summer) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_fall) <- "EPSG:4326"

rast_winter <- terra::project(rast_winter, "EPSG:4326")
rast_spring <- terra::project(rast_spring, "EPSG:4326")
rast_summer <- terra::project(rast_summer, "EPSG:4326")
rast_fall <- terra::project(rast_fall, "EPSG:4326")

ext(rast_winter) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_spring) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_summer) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_fall) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)

# Function to flip raster vertically and convert to data frame
raster_to_df <- function(rast, season_name) {
  # Flip raster on y-axis (vertical flip)
  rast_flipped <- flip(rast, direction = "vertical")

  # Convert to dataframe
  df <- as.data.frame(rast_flipped, xy = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("Lon", "Lat", "ChlorA")
  df$Season <- season_name
  return(df)
}

# Create dataframes for each season
df_winter <- raster_to_df(rast_winter, "Winter")
df_spring <- raster_to_df(rast_spring, "Spring")
df_summer <- raster_to_df(rast_summer, "Summer")
df_fall   <- raster_to_df(rast_fall, "Fall")

# Combine and apply the transformation
df_all_seasons <- bind_rows(df_winter, df_spring, df_summer, df_fall) %>%
  mutate(ChlorA_scaled = 10**(0.014999999664723873 * ChlorA - 2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Lon, Lat, Season, ChlorA, ChlorA_scaled) %>%
  distinct()

summary(df_all_seasons$ChlorA)
summary(df_all_seasons$ChlorA_scaled)

df_all_seasons <- df_all_seasons %>%
  mutate(
    Lon_rounded = round(Lon, 3),
    Lat_rounded = round(Lat, 3)
  )

# Create color palette
viridis_base <- as.character(paletteer_c("viridis::viridis", 10))

# Add color for higher values
hot_tail <- colorRampPalette(c(
  viridis_base[10],
  "#FDAE61",
  "#D73027"
))(6)

# Create custom color palette
my_palette <- c(viridis_base, hot_tail)

# Create df
df_all_seasons$Season <- factor(df_all_seasons$Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))

# Season shown in the top-left facet
season_topleft <- levels(df_all_seasons$Season)[4]

# North arrow location and size
arrow_x   <- california_bbox["xmin"] + 0.6
arrow_y   <- california_bbox["ymin"] + 0.6

# Define scaling for the rest of the code
scale_all <- 0.6

# Detach package to avoid same name function issue later
detach(package:terra, unload = TRUE)

# Create figure
Fig1Map <- ggplot(df_all_seasons, aes(x = Lon, y = Lat, fill = ChlorA_scaled)) +
  geom_raster() +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = california_bbox["xmax"] - 2.5,
      xmax = california_bbox["xmax"] - 0.1,
      ymin = california_bbox["ymax"] - 0.5,
      ymax = california_bbox["ymax"] - 0.1
    ),
    fill = "grey", color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  ## north arrow shaft
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = arrow_x,
      xend = arrow_x,
      y = arrow_y,
      yend = arrow_y + 0.6
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "white",
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.07, "in"))
  ) +

  ## "N" label
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = arrow_x,
      y = arrow_y + 0.8 + 0.15,
      label = "N"
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4 * scale_all,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(. ~ Season) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(california_bbox["xmin"], california_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(california_bbox["ymin"], california_bbox["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = my_palette,
    name = "ChlorA",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) paste0(y, "°")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-125, -117, by = 3),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "°")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey"),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8  * scale_all),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.6, "in"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.05, "in"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.2),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "gray90",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.2
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.4)
  ) +
    ## Scale bar: 200 km
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = scale_x_start,
      xend = scale_x_start + scale_lon,
      y = scale_y,
      yend = scale_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.3,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  ## Scale bar end ticks (corrected: three rows)
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(
      Season = rep(season_topleft, 2),
      x = c(
        scale_x_start,
        scale_x_start + scale_lon
      )
    ),
    aes(
      x = x,
      xend = x,
      y = scale_y - 0.08,
      yend = scale_y + 0.08
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.2,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  ## Scale bar label
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = scale_x_start + scale_lon / 2,
      y = scale_y + 0.3,
      label = "200 km"
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3 * scale_all,
    color = "white"
  )

Fig1Map

ggsave("Fig1.pdf", plot = Fig1Map, units = "in", width = 5, height = 4.25, device = "pdf")
```

# Morphological analysis

### Run the PCA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define traits columns
traits_columns <-
  c(
    # Size
    "area",
    "area_filled",
    "axis_major_length",
    "axis_minor_length",
    "equivalent_diameter_area",
    "perimeter_crofton",
    "feret_diameter_max",
    # Shape
    "circularity",
    "elongation",
    # Pixel intensity
    "range",
    "intensity_max",
    "intensity_mean",
    "intensity_std",
    # Complexity
    "perimareaexc",
    "feretareaexc",
    "perimmajor",
    "perimferet",
    "fractal_dimension"
  )

# Save non scaling data
features_processed_scale <- features_processed

# Scale only traits columns
features_processed_scale[, traits_columns] <- scale(features_processed_scale[, traits_columns])

# Save non transform data
features_processed_scale_yeo <- features_processed_scale

# Apply Yeo-Johnson Transformation on trait data
features_processed_scale_yeo[, traits_columns] <-
  sapply(features_processed_scale[, traits_columns], function(x)
    yeojohnson(x)$x.t)

# Save final data
features_processed_scale_yeo_norm <- features_processed_scale_yeo

# Run PCA
morpho_pca <- PCA(
  features_processed_scale_yeo_norm[, traits_columns],
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph = FALSE
)

# Bind PCA values and other variables
morpho_var_scores <- data.frame(morpho_pca$var$coord)
morpho_ind_scores <- data.frame(morpho_pca$ind$coord)
morpho_ind_scores <- cbind(
  morpho_ind_scores,
  dplyr::select(
    features_processed_scale_yeo_norm,
    objid,
    taxon,
    Line,
    Year,
    Year_month,
    Month,
    Day,
    Station,
    Season,
    #BEUTI_day_mean,
    Lon,
    Lat,
    Coast_distance,
    Nitra_depth,
    Temp_C,
    #Temp_C_surf,
    O2_mlL,
    #O2_mlL_surf,
    Sal_PSU,
    #Sal_PSU_surf,
    ChlorA,
    #ChlorA_surf#,
    #area,
    #intensity_mean
  )
)

summary(morpho_ind_scores)

write.csv(
  morpho_ind_scores,
  file.path(project_root, "morpho_ind_scores.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Extract eigen values
morpho_eig <- data.frame(eigenval = morpho_pca$eig[, 1])
morpho_eig$nb <- seq_along(morpho_eig$eigenval)
morpho_eig$prop <- morpho_eig$eigenval / sum(morpho_eig$eigenval)

# Plot the proportion of variance explained by PCs
ggplot(morpho_eig) + geom_bar(aes(x = nb, y = prop), stat = "identity") +
  geom_line(aes(x = nb, y = mean(prop))) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Eigenvalues") +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  ggtitle("Proportion of Eigenvalues")
```

### Plot morphological space

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate centroids for each taxon
morpho_taxo_centroids <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(Dim.1 = mean(Dim.1), Dim.2 = mean(Dim.2), Dim.3 = mean(Dim.3), Dim.4 = mean(Dim.4))

# Define constant
axis_size <- 7

# Extract correlations for morpho variables
morpho_cor_var <- as.data.frame(morpho_pca$var$coord)
threshold <- 0.15 # Set a threshold for correlation of 15%
filtered_morpho_var_scores_Dim1_Dim2 <-
  morpho_cor_var[apply(morpho_cor_var[, c("Dim.1", "Dim.2")], 1, function(x)
    any(abs(x) > threshold)),]
filtered_morpho_var_scores_Dim3_Dim4 <-
  morpho_cor_var[apply(morpho_cor_var[, c("Dim.3", "Dim.4")], 1, function(x)
    any(abs(x) > threshold)),]

# Define colors for traits categories
category_colors <- c(
  "Size" = "#E69F00",
  "Shape" = "#56B4E9",
  "Transparency" = "#009E73",
  "Complexity" = "#D55E00"
)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Prepare kmeans function
wss_mb <- function(k) {
  mb <- MiniBatchKmeans(
    data = x,
    clusters = k,
    batch_size = 1000,
    max_iters = 1000,
    init_fraction = 0.2,
    initializer = "kmeans++"
  )
  sum(mb$WCSS_per_cluster)
}
```

## Diversity indices

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate diversity metrics for each morphotype resolution.
set.seed(123)
x <- as.matrix(morpho_ind_scores[, c("Dim.1", "Dim.2", "Dim.3", "Dim.4")])

compute_morphotype_metrics <- function(k, coordinates, data) {
  model <- MiniBatchKmeans(
    coordinates,
    clusters = k,
    batch_size = 1000,
    max_iters = 1000,
    init_fraction = 0.2,
    initializer = "kmeans++"
  )
  clusters <- predict_MBatchKMeans(coordinates, model$centroids)
  label_col <- paste0("morphotype_label_", k)

  data[[paste0("morphotype_", k)]] <- clusters
  data[[label_col]] <- clusters

  traits <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(label_col))) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("Dim"), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::select(Dim.1, Dim.2, Dim.3, Dim.4, all_of(label_col)) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = label_col) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  community <- data %>%
    group_by(Year_month, Line, Station, across(all_of(label_col))) %>%
    summarise(morphotype_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = all_of(label_col),
      values_from = morphotype_count,
      values_fill = list(morphotype_count = 0)
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    `rownames<-`(paste(.$Year_month, .$Line, .$Station, sep = "_")) %>%
    dplyr::select(-Year_month, -Line, -Station) %>%
    as.matrix()

  richness <- fd_fric(traits, community, stand = FALSE)
  species_pool <- matrix(
    colSums(community),
    nrow = 1,
    dimnames = list("SpeciesPool", colnames(community))
  )
  FRic_pool <- fd_fric(traits, species_pool, stand = FALSE)$FRic
  richness$FRic_normalized <- richness$FRic / FRic_pool

  list(
    model = model,
    clusters = clusters,
    data = data,
    traits = traits,
    community = community,
    species_pool = species_pool,
    FRic_pool = FRic_pool,
    richness = richness,
    divergence = fd_fdiv(traits, community),
    eveness = fd_feve(traits, community, dist_matrix = NULL)
  )
}

for (k in c(400, 100, 200, 800)) {
  morphotype_fit <- compute_morphotype_metrics(k, x, morpho_ind_scores)
  morpho_ind_scores <- morphotype_fit$data
  mb <- morphotype_fit$model
  clusters <- morphotype_fit$clusters

  assign(paste0("traits_", k), morphotype_fit$traits)
  assign(paste0("sp_com_", k), morphotype_fit$community)
  assign(paste0("richness_", k), morphotype_fit$richness)
  assign(paste0("divergence_", k), morphotype_fit$divergence)
  assign(paste0("eveness_", k), morphotype_fit$eveness)
  assign(paste0("sp_com_pool_", k), morphotype_fit$species_pool)
  assign(paste0("FRic_pool_", k), morphotype_fit$FRic_pool)
}

# Compute mean values for all variables and merge diversity metrics
morpho_hypervolume <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(Year_month, Line, Station, Year, Month, Season, Coast_distance, Lat, Lon) %>%

    #Sal_PSU_surf = mean(Sal_PSU_surf, na.rm = TRUE),

    #O2_mlL_surf = mean(O2_mlL_surf, na.rm = TRUE),

    Dim2_mean = mean(Dim.2, na.rm = TRUE),

    Dim1_median = median(Dim.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim2_median = median(Dim.2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim3_median = median(Dim.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim4_median = median(Dim.4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  cbind(MRic_400 = richness_400$FRic_normalized,
        MDiv_400 = divergence_400$FDiv,
        MEve_400 = eveness_400$FEve,
        MRic_100 = richness_100$FRic_normalized,
        MDiv_100 = divergence_100$FDiv,
```

## By taxon
### Diversity indices

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate morphotype diversity separately for each taxonomic group.
morpho_hypervolume$site <- paste0(
  morpho_hypervolume$Year_month,
  "_",
  morpho_hypervolume$Line,
  "_",
  morpho_hypervolume$Station
)

reference <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  distinct(Year_month, Line, Station) %>%
  mutate(ref_id = paste(Year_month, Line, Station, sep = "_"))

taxa <- c(
  "copepoda_calanoida",
  "copepoda_eucalanids",
  "copepoda_harpacticoida",
  "copepoda_oithona",
  "copepoda_poecilostomatoids",
  "copepoda_others",
  "euphausiids",
  "nauplii",
  "ostracods",
  "crustacea_others",
  "appendicularia",
  "chaetognatha",
  "pyrosomes",
  "salps",
  "doliolids",
  "polychaete",
  "pteropoda",
  "rhizaria"
)

compute_taxon_diversity <- function(data, taxon_name, reference_data) {
  taxon_data <- data %>% filter(taxon == taxon_name)

  traits <- taxon_data %>%
    group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("Dim"), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::select(Dim.1, Dim.2, Dim.3, Dim.4, morphotype_label_400) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "morphotype_label_400") %>%
    as.data.frame()

  community <- taxon_data %>%
    group_by(Year_month, Line, Station, morphotype_label_400) %>%
    summarise(morphotype_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = morphotype_label_400,
      values_from = morphotype_count,
      values_fill = list(morphotype_count = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(ref_id = paste(Year_month, Line, Station, sep = "_")) %>%
    right_join(reference_data, by = "ref_id") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -Year_month.x, -Line.x, -Station.x,
      -Year_month.y, -Line.y, -Station.y
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "ref_id") %>%
    as.matrix()

  richness <- fd_fric(traits, community, stand = FALSE)
  divergence <- fd_fdiv(traits, community)
  eveness <- fd_feve(traits, community, dist_matrix = NULL)

  divergence[divergence == 0] <- NA
  divergence$FDiv[near(divergence$FDiv, 1)] <- NA

  list(
    taxon_data = taxon_data,
    traits = traits,
    community = community,
    richness = richness,
    divergence = divergence,
    eveness = eveness
  )
}

for (taxon in taxa) {
  taxon_fit <- compute_taxon_diversity(morpho_ind_scores, taxon, reference)

  assign(paste0("morpho_ind_scores_", taxon), taxon_fit$taxon_data)
  assign(paste0("traits_400_", taxon), taxon_fit$traits)
  assign(paste0("sp_com_400_", taxon), taxon_fit$community)
  assign(paste0("richness_400_", taxon), taxon_fit$richness)
  assign(paste0("divergence_400_", taxon), taxon_fit$divergence)
  assign(paste0("eveness_400_", taxon), taxon_fit$eveness)
}

join_taxon_metric <- function(data, metric_data, value_col, output_col) {
  metric_data <- metric_data %>% dplyr::select(site, all_of(value_col))
  names(metric_data)[2] <- output_col
  dplyr::left_join(data, metric_data, by = "site")
}

for (taxon in taxa) {
  morpho_hypervolume <- join_taxon_metric(
    morpho_hypervolume,
    get(paste0("richness_400_", taxon)),
    "FRic",
    paste0("MRic_400_", taxon)
  )
  morpho_hypervolume <- join_taxon_metric(
    morpho_hypervolume,
    get(paste0("eveness_400_", taxon)),
    "FEve",
    paste0("MEve_400_", taxon)
  )
  morpho_hypervolume <- join_taxon_metric(
    morpho_hypervolume,
    get(paste0("divergence_400_", taxon)),
    "FDiv",
    paste0("MDiv_400_", taxon)
  )
}
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Create confidence interval function
mean_ci95 <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
  t_val <- qt(0.975, df = length(x) - 1)
  data.frame(y = m, ymin = m - t_val * se, ymax = m + t_val * se)
}
```

### Morphotype composition

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Compute the number of unique taxa per morphotype
taxa_per_morphotype <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  summarise(num_taxa = n_distinct(taxon), .groups = "drop")

summary_stats <- taxa_per_morphotype %>%
  summarise(
    mean_taxa = mean(num_taxa),
    median_taxa = median(num_taxa),
    min_taxa = min(num_taxa),
    max_taxa = max(num_taxa),
    sd_taxa = sd(num_taxa)
  )

print(summary_stats)

# Compute contributions
taxa_contrib_filtered <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400, taxon) %>%
  summarise(taxon_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(taxon_count),
         relative_contribution = 100 * taxon_count / total_count) %>%
  filter(relative_contribution > 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# Get top 3 taxa by contribution for each morphotype
top3_taxa <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400, taxon) %>%
  summarise(taxon_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(taxon_count),
         relative_contribution = 100 * taxon_count / total_count) %>%
  arrange(desc(relative_contribution)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = relative_contribution, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create separate data frames
rank1 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 1)
rank2 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 2)
rank3 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 3)

# Count dominant morphotypes per taxon for each rank
count_per_rank <- function(data, rank_label) {
  data %>%
    count(taxon, name = "n_morphotypes") %>%
    mutate(rank = rank_label)
}

df_rank1 <- count_per_rank(rank1, "1st")
df_rank2 <- count_per_rank(rank2, "2nd")
df_rank3 <- count_per_rank(rank3, "3rd")

# Combine all ranks
combined_counts <- bind_rows(df_rank1, df_rank2, df_rank3)

# Plot
taxa_contribution <- ggplot(combined_counts, aes(x = reorder(taxon, n_morphotypes),
                                                 y = n_morphotypes, fill = rank)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Contribution of taxonomic ranks to morphotype richness",
    x = "Taxon",
    y = "Number of morphotypes (400)",
    fill = "Rank of contribution"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
```

# Abundance and biomass

#### Load and prepare data

```{r}
abd_data <-
  read.csv(
    file.path(project_root, "PROPOOS_data_export_1783450398.7017.csv"),
    header = TRUE, sep = ";"
  )

# Ensure it's a data frame
abd_data <- as.data.frame(abd_data)

# --- Step 1: Extract Year, Month, Year-Month ---
abd_data <- abd_data %>%
  mutate(
    Year  = str_sub(Cruise, 1, 4),
    Month = str_sub(Cruise, 5, 6),
    Year_month = paste0(Year, "/", Month),
    Station = as.vector(Station)
  )

# --- Step 3: Identify abundance and biomass columns ---
abundance_cols <- grep("\\.Abundance", names(abd_data), value = TRUE)
biomass_cols   <- grep("\\.Biomass",   names(abd_data), value = TRUE)

# --- Step 4: Pivot abundance to long ---
abd_data_long_abd <- abd_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year_month, Station, Line, all_of(abundance_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -c(Year_month, Station, Line),
    names_to  = "Taxa",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Taxa = str_remove(Taxa, "\\.Abundance.*"))

# --- Step 5: Pivot biomass to long ---
abd_data_long_bio <- abd_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Year_month, Station, Line, all_of(biomass_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -c(Year_month, Station, Line),
    names_to  = "Taxa",
    values_to = "Biomass"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Taxa = str_remove(Taxa, "\\.Estimated\\.C\\.Biomass.*"))

# --- Step 6: Merge abundance & biomass ---
abd_data_long <- full_join(
  abd_data_long_abd,
  abd_data_long_bio,
  by = c("Year_month", "Station", "Line", "Taxa")
)

abd_data_long <- abd_data_long %>%
  filter(!Taxa %in% c("eggs", "multiples", "bryozoan_larvae", "cnidaria_ctenophores", "others"))

# --- Step 10: Rename Taxa to match taxa_colors ---
taxa_rename_map <- c(
  # Crustacea cop
  "copepoda_calanoida_minus_eucalanids" = "Copepoda_calanoida",
  "copepoda_eucalanids"                 = "Copepoda_eucalanids",
  "copepoda_harpacticoida"              = "Copepoda_harpacticoida",
  "copepoda_oithona_like"               = "Copepoda_oithona",
  "copepoda_poecilostomatoids"          = "Copepoda_poecilostomatoids",
  "copepoda_others"                     = "Copepoda_others",

  # Crustacea non cop
  "euphausiids"                         = "Euphausiids",
  "nauplii"                             = "Nauplii",
  "ostracods"                           = "Ostracods",
  "crustacea_others"                    = "Crustacea_others",

  # Gelatinous
  "appendicularia"                      = "Appendicularia",
  "chaetognatha"                        = "Chaetognatha",
  "pyrosomes"                           = "Pyrosomes",
  "salps"                               = "Salps",
  "doliolids"                           = "Doliolids",

  # The rest
  "polychaete"                          = "Polychaete",
  "pteropoda_heteropoda"                = "Pteropoda",
  "rhizaria"                            = "Rhizaria",
  "Copepoda_noncalanoida"               = "copepoda_others",
  "pyrosomes"                           = "Pyrosomes"
)

abd_data_long <- abd_data_long %>%
  mutate(Taxa = recode(Taxa, !!!taxa_rename_map))

abd_data_coast <- abd_data_long %>%
  group_by(Line, Station, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Biomass   = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    features_processed %>%
      dplyr::select(Station, Line, Coast_distance) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("Station", "Line")
  )

abd_data_year <- abd_data_long %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(substr(Year_month, 1, 4))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Line, Year, Taxa) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Biomass   = median(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

station_totals <- abd_data_coast %>%
  group_by(Line, Station, Coast_distance) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_biomass   = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Line, Coast_distance)

station_totals <- station_totals %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance_txt = sprintf("%.2f × 10^%d",
                            Total_abundance / 10^floor(log10(Total_abundance)),
                            floor(log10(Total_abundance))),
    Biomass_txt = round(Total_biomass, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Line, Station, Coast_distance, Total_abundance, Abundance_txt, Total_biomass, Biomass_txt)

abd_percent <- abd_data_coast %>%
  group_by(Taxa) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = 100 * Abundance / sum(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percent))
abd_percent

bio_percent <- abd_data_coast %>%
  group_by(Taxa) %>%
  summarise(Biomass = sum(Biomass), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = 100 * Biomass / sum(Biomass)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percent))
bio_percent
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define a proper scale for
fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = taxa_colors)

# Define text names
dat_text_A_B <- data.frame(
  label = c("A", "B"),
  Line   = c(80, 90)
)
dat_text_C_D <- data.frame(
  label = c("C", "D"),
  Line   = c(80, 90)
)

# Abundance vs Coast distance
row1 <- ggplot(abd_data_coast, aes(x = Coast_distance, y = Abundance, fill = Taxa)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(Line ~ ., scales = "fixed", nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(Line = c("80" = "Line 80", "90" = "Line 90"))) +
  scale_x_reverse(
  breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 200, 300, 500, 700),
  limits = c(700, -20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) {
      sapply(x, function(y) {
        if (is.na(y)) return(NA)
        if (y == 0) return("0")
        expo <- floor(log10(abs(y)))
        base <- y / 10^expo
        bquote(.(round(base, 2)) %*% 10^.(expo))
      })
    },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  fill_scale +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = expression("Abundance (Ind. "~m^{-2}~")"), x = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all, margin = margin(t = 1, b = 1)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),

    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.3)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL, nrow = 3), byrow = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
  data    = dat_text_A_B,
  mapping = aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,

  fontface = "bold",

  )
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(Line ~ Taxa_group, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = every_two_years) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) {
      sapply(x, function(y) {
        if (is.na(y)) return(NA)
        if (y == 0) return("0")
        expo <- floor(log10(abs(y)))
        base <- y / 10^expo
        bquote(.(round(base, 2)) %*% 10^.(expo))
      })
    },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = expression("Biomass (mgC. "~m^{-2}~")"), x = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

    color = "black",

  )
```

### Prepare model plots

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper to get min/max from visreg for a variable
get_visreg_range <- function(model, var, by = "Line", breaks = NULL) {
  p <- visreg(model, var, by = by, overlay = TRUE, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)

  visreg_data <- data.frame(
    x = p$fit[[var]],
    fit = p$fit$visregFit,
    lwr = p$fit$visregLwr,
    upr = p$fit$visregUpr
  )

  # Apply special rule for Coast_distance: ignore min values after 400 km
  if (var == "Coast_distance") {
    visreg_data <- visreg_data %>%
      mutate(fit_for_range = ifelse(x > 400, NA, fit),
             lwr_for_range = ifelse(x > 400, NA, lwr))
    range_vals <- range(c(visreg_data$fit_for_range, visreg_data$lwr_for_range, visreg_data$upr), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    range_vals <- range(c(visreg_data$fit, visreg_data$lwr, visreg_data$upr), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  range_vals
}

clip_visreg_layers <- function(plot, mins, maxs) {
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) {
    df <- plot$layers[[i]]$data
    if (!is.data.frame(df) || !"Line" %in% names(df)) next

    xcol <- if ("x" %in% names(df)) {
      "x"
    } else if ("Coast_distance" %in% names(df)) {
      "Coast_distance"
    } else {
      next
    }

    idx <- as.character(df$Line)
    keep <- !is.na(mins[idx]) & df[[xcol]] >= mins[idx] & df[[xcol]] <= maxs[idx]
    plot$layers[[i]]$data <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  plot
}

style_visreg_layers <- function(plot, set_first_alpha = TRUE) {
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) {
    if (inherits(plot$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomPolygon")) {
      plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- NA
      plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- 0
    }
  }

  plot$layers <- plot$layers[
    !sapply(plot$layers, function(layer) inherits(layer$geom, "GeomPoint"))
  ]
  if (set_first_alpha) plot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.1
  plot$layers[[2]]$aes_params$alpha <- 1
  plot$layers[[2]]$aes_params$size <- 0.3

  plot
}

# Variables to check
vars <- c("Year", "Coast_distance", "Season")
# Compute combined y-axis range across all variables
PC1_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC1, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
PC2_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC2, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
PC3_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC3, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
Rich_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_rich, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
Eve_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_eve, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate observed annual means and 95% confidence intervals
get_observed_year_summary <- function(model) {

  # Recover the exact observations used by the GAM
  mf <- model.frame(model)

  # Extract response variable and explanatory variables
  observed_data <- data.frame(
    Year = as.numeric(mf$Year),
    Line = factor(mf$Line),
    value = as.numeric(model.response(mf))
  )

  # Calculate observed means and 95% confidence intervals
  observed_summary <- observed_data %>%
    group_by(Year, Line) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(value),
      sd = sd(value),
      se = sd / sqrt(n),
      lower = if (n() > 1) {
        mean(value) - qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(value) / sqrt(n())
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper = if (n() > 1) {
        mean(value) + qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(value) / sqrt(n())
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(observed_summary)
}

# Add observed means and confidence intervals to a GAM plot
add_observed_year_summary <- function(plot, model) {

  observed_data <- get_observed_year_summary(model)

  plot +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = observed_data,
      aes(
        x = Year,
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = factor(Line)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      width = 0.15,
      size = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = observed_data,
      aes(
        x = Year,
        y = mean,
        colour = factor(Line)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1
    )
}
```

#### Year: observed values
```{r}
#### Observed values: shared functions

# Extract observations used by the GAM and calculate means and 95% CIs
get_observed_summary <- function(model, x_var, x_levels = NULL) {

  mf <- model.frame(model)

  x <- mf[[x_var]]

  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    x <- factor(x, levels = x_levels)
  } else {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
  }

  observed_data <- data.frame(
    x = x,
    Line = factor(mf$Line),
    value = as.numeric(model.response(mf))
  )

  observed_summary <- observed_data %>%
    group_by(x, Line) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs = n(),
      mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean - qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean + qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(observed_summary)
}


# Common plot theme
observed_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {

  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14 * scale_all,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) c(0.02, 0.02) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.65),
        colour = NA
      ),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "in"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "gray90",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
    )
}


# Build plots of observed values with LOESS smooths
make_observed_continuous_plot <- function(
    model,
    x_var,
    y_label,
    panel_label,
    x_label,
    title = NULL,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    reverse_x = FALSE,
    x_breaks = NULL,
    ylim = NULL,
    year_background = FALSE,
    loess_span = 0.75) {

  observed <- get_observed_summary(model, x_var)

  # Use every second sampled year for the x-axis
  if (x_var == "Year" && is.null(x_breaks)) {
    all_years <- sort(unique(observed$x))
    x_breaks <- all_years[seq(1, length(all_years), by = 2)]
  }

  p <- ggplot(observed, aes(x = x, y = mean))

  # Background periods for annual plots
  if (year_background) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    # General LOESS smooth fitted to observed group means
    geom_smooth(
      aes(colour = Line, group = Line),
      method = "loess",
      formula = y ~ x,
      span = loess_span,
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    # Observed means and 95% confidence intervals
    geom_linerange(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = Line
      ),
      linewidth = 0.2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = Line),
      size = 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      name = "CalCOFI Lines",
      values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")
    ) +

    labs(
      y = y_label,
      x = x_label,
      title = title
    ) +

    observed_theme(show_legend)

  if (reverse_x) {
    p <- p + scale_x_reverse(breaks = x_breaks)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks)
  }

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  }

  # Panel label
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = if (reverse_x) Inf else -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = panel_label,
      hjust = -0.5,
      vjust = 1.5,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7 * scale_all
    )

  return(p)
}


# Remove x-axis title and labels for upper panels
blank_x_axis <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate observed means and 95% confidence intervals
# at each sampled coast distance, separately for each line

get_observed_coast_summary <- function(model) {

  # Retrieve the exact observations used by the GAM
  mf <- model.frame(model)

  observed_data <- data.frame(
    Coast_distance = mf$Coast_distance,
    Line = mf$Line,
    value = as.numeric(model.response(mf))
  )

  observed_summary <- observed_data %>%
    group_by(Line, Coast_distance) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_value = mean(value),
      obs_sd = stats::sd(value),
      lower = if (n() > 1) {
        mean_value - qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * obs_sd / sqrt(n())
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper = if (n() > 1) {
        mean_value + qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * obs_sd / sqrt(n())
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(observed_summary)
}

# Add observed means and confidence intervals to a GAM plot

add_observed_coast_summary <- function(plot, model) {

  observed_data <- get_observed_coast_summary(model)

  plot +
    geom_linerange(
      data = observed_data,
      aes(
        x = Coast_distance,
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = factor(Line)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = observed_data,
      aes(
        x = Coast_distance,
        y = mean_value,
        colour = factor(Line)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1
    )
}
```

#### Cross-shore: observed values 
```{r}
#### Observed values: shared functions

# Extract observations used by the GAM and calculate means and 95% CIs
get_observed_summary <- function(model, x_var, x_levels = NULL) {

  mf <- model.frame(model)

  x <- mf[[x_var]]

  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    x <- factor(x, levels = x_levels)
  } else {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
  }

  observed_data <- data.frame(
    x = x,
    Line = factor(mf$Line),
    value = as.numeric(model.response(mf))
  )

  observed_summary <- observed_data %>%
    group_by(x, Line) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs = n(),
      mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean - qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean + qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(observed_summary)
}


# Common plot theme
observed_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {

  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14 * scale_all,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) c(0.02, 0.02) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.65),
        colour = NA
      ),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "in"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "gray90",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
    )
}


# Build plots of observed values with LOESS smooths
make_observed_continuous_plot <- function(
    model,
    x_var,
    y_label,
    panel_label,
    x_label,
    title = NULL,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    reverse_x = FALSE,
    x_breaks = NULL,
    ylim = NULL,
    year_background = FALSE,
    loess_span = 0.75) {

  observed <- get_observed_summary(model, x_var)

  # Use every second sampled year for the x-axis
  if (x_var == "Year" && is.null(x_breaks)) {
    all_years <- sort(unique(observed$x))
    x_breaks <- all_years[seq(1, length(all_years), by = 2)]
  }

  p <- ggplot(observed, aes(x = x, y = mean))

  # Background periods for annual plots
  if (year_background) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    # General LOESS smooth fitted to observed group means
    geom_smooth(
      aes(colour = Line, group = Line),
      method = "loess",
      formula = y ~ x,
      span = loess_span,
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    # Observed means and 95% confidence intervals
    geom_linerange(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = Line
      ),
      linewidth = 0.2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = Line),
      size = 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      name = "CalCOFI Lines",
      values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")
    ) +

    labs(
      y = y_label,
      x = x_label,
      title = title
    ) +

    observed_theme(show_legend)

  if (reverse_x) {
    p <- p + scale_x_reverse(breaks = x_breaks)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks)
  }

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  }

  # Panel label
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = if (reverse_x) Inf else -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = panel_label,
      hjust = -0.5,
      vjust = 1.5,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7 * scale_all
    )

  return(p)
}


# Remove x-axis title and labels for upper panels
blank_x_axis <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
#### Observed values: shared functions

# Extract observations used by the GAM and calculate means and 95% CIs
get_observed_summary <- function(model, x_var, x_levels = NULL) {

  mf <- model.frame(model)

  x <- mf[[x_var]]

  if (!is.null(x_levels)) {
    x <- factor(x, levels = x_levels)
  } else {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
  }

  observed_data <- data.frame(
    x = x,
    Line = factor(mf$Line),
    value = as.numeric(model.response(mf))
  )

  observed_summary <- observed_data %>%
    group_by(x, Line) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs = n(),
      mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean - qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      upper = if (n_obs > 1) {
        mean + qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1) * sd / sqrt(n_obs)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  return(observed_summary)
}


# Common plot theme
observed_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {

  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 14 * scale_all,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) c(0.02, 0.02) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
      legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
      legend.background = element_rect(
        fill = rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.65),
        colour = NA
      ),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "in"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "gray90",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
    )
}


# Build plots of observed values with LOESS smooths
make_observed_continuous_plot <- function(
    model,
    x_var,
    y_label,
    panel_label,
    x_label,
    title = NULL,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    reverse_x = FALSE,
    x_breaks = NULL,
    ylim = NULL,
    year_background = FALSE,
    loess_span = 0.75) {

  observed <- get_observed_summary(model, x_var)

  # Use every second sampled year for the x-axis
  if (x_var == "Year" && is.null(x_breaks)) {
    all_years <- sort(unique(observed$x))
    x_breaks <- all_years[seq(1, length(all_years), by = 2)]
  }

  p <- ggplot(observed, aes(x = x, y = mean))

  # Background periods for annual plots
  if (year_background) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      ) +
      annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    # General LOESS smooth fitted to observed group means
    geom_smooth(
      aes(colour = Line, group = Line),
      method = "loess",
      formula = y ~ x,
      span = loess_span,
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    # Observed means and 95% confidence intervals
    geom_linerange(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = Line
      ),
      linewidth = 0.2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = Line),
      size = 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      name = "CalCOFI Lines",
      values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")
    ) +

    labs(
      y = y_label,
      x = x_label,
      title = title
    ) +

    observed_theme(show_legend)

  if (reverse_x) {
    p <- p + scale_x_reverse(breaks = x_breaks)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks)
  }

  if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  }

  # Panel label
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = if (reverse_x) Inf else -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = panel_label,
      hjust = -0.5,
      vjust = 1.5,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7 * scale_all
    )

  return(p)
}


# Remove x-axis title and labels for upper panels
blank_x_axis <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank()
    )
}

#### Season: observed values

season_levels <- c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall")


# Build plots from observed seasonal means and confidence intervals
make_observed_season_plot <- function(
    model,
    y_label,
    panel_label,
    title = NULL,
    show_legend = FALSE) {

  observed <- get_observed_summary(
    model,
    x_var = "Season",
    x_levels = season_levels
  )

  p <- ggplot(observed, aes(x = x, y = mean)) +

    # Observed means and 95% confidence intervals
    geom_linerange(
      aes(
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        colour = Line,
        group = Line
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      linewidth = 0.3,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        colour = Line,
        group = Line
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      size = 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "CalCOFI Lines",
      values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")
    ) +

    labs(
      y = y_label,
      x = "",
      title = title
    ) +

    observed_theme(show_legend) +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = panel_label,
      hjust = -0.5,
      vjust = 1.5,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 7 * scale_all
    )

  if (show_legend) {
    p <- p +
      guides(
        color = guide_legend(
          override.aes = list(size = 0.5)
        )
      )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mega_gam_rich_100 <- gam(
  MRic_100 ~
    s(Year, by = Line) +
    s(Coast_distance, by = Line) +
    s(Temp_C) +
    s(ChlorA_transform) +
    s(Sal_PSU) +
    s(Transparency) +

)

p <- visreg(mega_gam_rich_100, "Year", by = "Line", overlay = TRUE, breaks = 3, gg = TRUE)

p <- style_visreg_layers(p)
visreg_data <- p$data
all_years <- sort(unique(visreg_data$x))
every_two_years <- all_years[seq(1, length(all_years), by = 2)]

plot_rich_year_100 <- p +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
  aes(color = factor(Line), fill = factor(Line), linetype = factor(Line)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_ci95, geom = "linerange", size = 0.1, alpha = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "solid", "90" = "solid")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = every_two_years) +
  labs(y = "Richness (k = 100)", x = "Year") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14 * scale_all, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    # place legend inside bottom-left of plotting area
    legend.position = c(0.02, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    # make legend readable on top of the plot
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = rgb(1,1,1,0.65), colour = NA),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "in"),
    # the rest of your theme
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.2),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    fill = "gray90",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.3)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "A"),
    hjust = -0.5,
    vjust = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 7 * scale_all
  )

    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8 * scale_all),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.2),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    fill = "gray90",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.3)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "D"),
    hjust = -0.5,
    vjust = 1.5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 7 * scale_all
  )

plot_rich_year_100 <- plot_rich_year_100 + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                                 axis.text.x = element_blank())
plot_rich_year_200 <- plot_rich_year_200 + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                                 axis.text.x = element_blank())

# Combine plots with headers
GAM_Supp <-
   (plot_rich_year_100 / plot_rich_year_400) | (plot_rich_year_200 / plot_rich_year_800)

GAM_Supp

ggsave("FigS5.png", plot = GAM_Supp, units = "in", width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 1200, device = "png")
```

# Supplementary taxonomic trait figures

```{r}
# Pre-calculate summary statistics (Crunches 1M rows into a lightweight table)
morpho_summary <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(Dim.1)) %>%
  group_by(taxon, Year, Line) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    mean_val = mean(Dim.1),
    sd_val   = sd(Dim.1),
    se_val   = sd_val / sqrt(n_obs),
    # 95% CI calculation matching your template function
    t_val    = qt(0.975, df = n_obs - 1),
    ymin     = mean_val - (t_val * se_val),
    ymax     = mean_val + (t_val * se_val),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# Calculate total observations per taxon for the y-axis labels
taxon_totals <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(total_n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 1. Define the specific taxa you want to keep
# Note: Check your exact dataset spelling if any of these don't show up!
target_taxa <- c(
  "ostracods",
  "polychaete",
  "euphausiids",
  "copepoda_calanoida",
  "nauplii",
  "chaetognatha",
  "appendicularia",
  "copepoda_oithona",
  "rhizaria"
)

# 2. Filter your pre-aggregated datasets
morpho_summary_filtered <- morpho_summary %>% filter(taxon %in% target_taxa)
taxon_totals_filtered <- taxon_totals %>% filter(taxon %in% target_taxa)

# 3. Layout Configuration
num_cols <- 3
taxa_list <- sort(unique(morpho_summary_filtered$taxon)) # Sorted alphabetically
total_plots <- length(taxa_list)

# Define years interval dynamically
all_years <- sort(unique(morpho_summary_filtered$Year))
every_two_years <- all_years[seq(1, length(all_years), by = 2)]

if (!exists("scale_all")) scale_all <- 1
plot_list <- list()

# 4. Generate the plots
for (i in seq_along(taxa_list)) {
  current_taxon <- taxa_list[i]

  # SMART AXIS CONTROL: True if there is no plot directly below this one in the grid
  is_terminal_plot <- (i + num_cols > total_plots)

  # Filter data for this specific taxon
  taxon_data <- morpho_summary_filtered %>% filter(taxon == current_taxon)
  total_n <- taxon_totals_filtered %>% filter(taxon == current_taxon) %>% pull(total_n)

  plot_label <- LETTERS[i]

  p <- ggplot(data = taxon_data, aes(x = Year, y = mean_val, color = factor(Line))) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +

    aes(color = factor(Line), fill = factor(Line), linetype = factor(Line)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 1) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 1) +

    scale_fill_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "solid", "90" = "solid")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = every_two_years) +

    # Cleans up axis labels by wrapping text lines automatically if they are too long
    labs(y = paste0(stringr::str_wrap(current_taxon, width = 15), "\n(n = ", format(total_n, big.mark=","), ")")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
      strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all, margin = margin(t = 1, b = 1)),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf), label = plot_label,
      hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 7 * scale_all
    )

  # Set main title only on the top-left plot (Panel A)
  if (i == 2) {
    p <- p + labs(title = "Morphological Size (PC1) - Interannual variation") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14 * scale_all, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  }

  # Dynamic X-axis visibility rule based on terminal column positioning
  if (is_terminal_plot) {
    p <- p + labs(x = "Year") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank())
  }

  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# 5. Combine using 3 columns (Patchwork leaves the 9th slot cleanly empty)
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = num_cols)
combined_plot

ggsave("FigS14.png", plot = combined_plot, units = "in", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 1200, device = "png")
```
